name: MACD signal
summary: This EA trades based on MACD signal line crossovers, entering long positions when the MACD line crosses above the signal line and short positions when it crosses below. It uses configurable lot sizing and stop loss/take profit levels for trade management. The strategy is a classic momentum-based approach relying on MACD histogram direction changes for trade signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MACD信号线交叉进行交易，当MACD线上穿信号线时做多，下穿时做空。它使用可配置的手数和止损/止盈水平进行仓位管理。该策略是经典的动量方法，依赖MACD柱状图方向变化产生交易信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是MACD指标的金叉和死叉信号，属于经典的动量跟踪策略。入场条件为MACD主线与信号线发生交叉，金叉做多，死叉做空，典型的趋势启动捕捉逻辑。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈参数，没有追踪止损或动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏风险比例控制，没有根据ATR或账户权益计算最优仓位。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on MACD line and signal line crossovers, which is a classic momentum-following approach. Entry conditions trigger when the MACD main line crosses above the signal line for long positions and below for short positions, capturing trend initiation signals. Exit conditions rely on predefined stop loss and take profit parameters, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or market volatility. Money management lacks risk proportion control, as it does not calculate optimal position size based on ATR or account equity. The overall strategy logic is straightforward, but it is prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets that can lead to consecutive losses.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和维护
MACD是经过长期验证的经典动量指标，可靠性较高
参数可配置，允许用户根据不同市场环境优化设置
止损止盈机制保护资金安全
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy to understand and maintain
MACD is a well-established classic momentum indicator with proven reliability
Configurable parameters allow users to optimize settings for different market conditions
Stop loss and take profit mechanisms protect capital safety
cons: 震荡行情中容易产生大量虚假信号导致频繁亏损
固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动调整风险敞口
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺乏追踪止损功能，无法锁定浮动利润
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下交易成本可能过高
cons_en: Prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
Lacks trailing stop functionality, unable to lock in floating profits
No spread filter, trading costs may be excessive in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损和仓位计算，根据市场波动率自动调整风险敞口
添加趋势过滤条件（如大周期MA方向），避免在震荡行情中频繁交易
实现新K线检查机制和点差过滤，提高交易执行的可靠性
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and position sizing to automatically adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Implement trend filter conditions (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction) to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets
Implement new bar check mechanism and spread filter to improve trade execution reliability

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查，可能在同一K线上重复开仓造成过度交易
固定手数未与账户权益挂钩，大比例亏损时风险敞口不变
没有点差过滤，低流动性时段可能因滑点和高点差遭受额外损失
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar check may cause over-trading by repeatedly opening positions on the same bar
Fixed lot size is not linked to account equity, keeping risk exposure unchanged during large drawdowns
No spread filter may cause additional losses from slippage and high spreads during low liquidity sessions

summary_en: This EA trades based on MACD signal line crossovers, entering long positions when the MACD line crosses above the signal line and short positions when it crosses below. It uses configurable lot sizing and stop loss/take profit levels for trade management. The strategy is a classic momentum-based approach relying on MACD histogram direction changes for trade signals.
